Govt Delays UPI Merchant Transaction Fee Implementation

The Indian government has postponed the implementation of fees on UPI merchant transactions. The charges were initially scheduled to take effect on October 15, but will now be applied after Diwali. This decision impacts how merchants using UPI for payments will be charged.
